model: two conditional heteroscedastic MLP experts with explicit likelihood-ratio margin
condition_features: Franka joint positions normalized by design limits
EEF translation relative to episode initial pose divided by 0.855 m reach
gripper position divided by robot-specific full stroke
current command displacement norm divided by reach
rotation-command displacement norm divided by pi
previous EEF response divided by reach

continue_to_ensemble_only_if: source calibration likelihood ratio retains useful separation
normal episode high-score windows are reduced without erasing synthetic anomaly ordering

target_rule: No LIBERO-10 fitting; any later LIBERO-10 use is diagnostic-only after source model freeze.
